description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractWithOrigin that implements the WithOrigin interface, providing a base implementation for managing an optional ActorRef named 'origin'. It includes a nullable actor reference and a method to retrieve it wrapped in an Optional.

classes.name: AbstractWithOrigin
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing WithOrigin, encapsulating an optional ActorRef 'origin' and providing a method to access it.

methods.name: AbstractWithOrigin
methods.description: Constructor initializing the 'origin' ActorRef, which can be null.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the ActorRef 'origin' if it is not null.
